vendors.name: Tellin Mak
vendors.title: Scrap Broker
vendors.description: A Reclaimer who knows the price of everything and the value of most things. Will trade you nearly anything for TC.

vendors.name: Vesryn of Varakush
vendors.title: Order Scholar
vendors.description: A Forgotten Order scholar carrying relics and runecasters for the careful researcher. Speaks in long sentences.

vendors.name: Korash of the Deep
vendors.title: True Tartarian Quartermaster
vendors.description: A subterranean quartermaster trading in heavier gear. Speaks little. Watches your hands.

vendors.name: Naha
vendors.title: Wandering Drifter
vendors.description: An unaffiliated traveller with a mixed pack. The prices are sometimes generous, sometimes not. Depends on the day.
